ashley (infra): Heads up — we're seeing sustained admission throttles on several reserved pools in us-east-2. Committed tenants are getting 429s and queue depth is climbing rapidly.

nina (oncall): alerted by paging. I can confirm error spike started ~00:12 UTC, coincides with a big increase in short-latency chat requests.

raj (sre): load looks like lots of concurrent tiny requests rather than long token streams. Fairshare is getting starved.

lin (runtime): checking runtime metrics — KV cache hit rate is fine, but per-GPU QPS jumped ~2.1x and admission controller is tripping preset rate caps.

ashley (infra): suspect rollout of model v2 to hosted tier triggered client retry storms. Any recent rollout events?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deploy completed by @devops at 00:10 UTC: service: chat-service, image: chat:v2-rc3.

raj (sre): yep that matches. Can we temporarily loosen committed-pool admission caps for us-east-2 to let current tenants finish? We should avoid breaking SLOs but need to stop hard 429s.

tom (platform): cost note — any temporary raise will burn burst credits and may bump committed billing if kept >1h. Approve for 30m?

nina (oncall): suggest: 1) pause the rollout to hosted clients, 2) bump RX admit limit +20% on reserved pools in us-east-2 for 15m, 3) evict any non-prod low-priority slots.

lin (runtime): prepping admit patch: applying: 
```
admission.max_requests_per_gpu = admission.max_requests_per_gpu * 1.2
admission.eviction_policy = "low-priority-first"
```
Will push to canary now.

raj (sre): also adding a short-lived routing rule: route best-effort traffic to eu-west fallback cluster for matching tenant tags to reduce pressure. Needs quick DNS / routing tweak.

ashley (infra): executing plan. Pausing deployment and applying admit bump + eviction. Tom approved 30m bump via DM.

ops-bot: autoscaler: non-prod pools in us-east-2 scaled down by 40% (evicted 3 low-priority jobs).

lin (runtime): admit bump applied to canary GPUs at 00:23 UTC. Canary looks stable and 429s dropped ~60% for those tenants. Rolling to remainder now.

nina (oncall): monitoring queues: queue depth peaked 28k -> 6.5k after measures. Latency SLO for committed tenants improved.

raj (sre): follow-ups: 1) add a deploy-safety guard to throttle rollout rate based on per-region admission headroom, 2) improve backoff guidance for SDK clients to avoid retry storms.

tom (platform): agree. Also: implement a short-circuit that will temporarily route best-effort traffic off reserved pools when utilization >85% for 2 consecutive minutes.

ashley (infra): creating incident ticket and postmortem placeholder. Will include cost delta for boost.

nina (oncall): keeping this thread open for 1h to confirm no regressions. Will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-note: mitigation applied at 00:23 UTC, queues draining.
